rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi/tatpuruṣa-based compound sarva-deva-mayaḥ; final visarga dropped before bhavet

items.question: What all-encompassing sacred identity is attained by one who honors the dūtikā?
premises: One who honors the dūtikā is declared consisting of all sacred sites.
The same person would become consisting of all deities.
This sacred identity encompasses both pilgrimage sites and divine powers.
items.inference: Honoring the dūtikā confers an identity that embodies all sacred sites and all deities.
uncertainties: The subject is implied from the preceding verses rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: He is declared to consist of all sacred sites and would become one who consists of all deities.
